DisCoder
--------
Repository: https://github.com/ETH-DISCO/discoder
Commit: main branch (latest as of 2025-11-21)
Date Vendored: 2025-11-21
License: MIT
Purpose: High-fidelity neural vocoder using neural audio codecs

Files vendored:
- models.py - Core DisCoder model architecture
- utils.py - Utility functions for mel extraction and audio processing
- meldataset.py - Audio loading and mel spectrogram dataset utilities
- modules.py - Network building blocks (ResBlock, Snake activation, etc.)
- discriminator.py - GAN discriminator for training
- filter.py - Audio filtering utilities

See LICENSES/DisCoder-LICENSE for full license text.
